howItWorks.title: How SOORAR Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Five simple, stress-free steps from your first call to settling into your new space.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fill out our online booking form or message us directly on WhatsApp (+252 770 505 028).
howItWorks.step2Desc: Receive an honest, all-inclusive price covering truck, crew, and wrapping with no hidden fees.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Pick your preferred date and morning or afternoon slot; we assign your truck and crew.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Our uniformed blue team wraps furniture, dismantles beds/wardrobes, and loads with care.
howItWorks.step5Desc: We place items room-by-room, reassemble your furniture, and complete the final checklist!

whySoorar.title: Why Choose SOORAR?
whySoorar.subtitle: Your home, in safe hands.
whySoorar.safetyDesc: Heavy moving blankets, multi-layer bubble wrap, and clean enclosed box trucks protect every item.
whySoorar.onTimeDesc: We respect your schedule. Our supervisor calls you 30 minutes before arrival.
whySoorar.honestyDesc: The quote we agree on is what you pay. We accept EVC Plus, Zaad, eDahab, Cash, and Bank Transfer.
whySoorar.expertiseDesc: Experienced carpenters and movers trained to disassemble and reassemble complex wardrobes and office setups.

about.title: The SOORAR Story – "Soo Rar"
about.lead: Our name comes from the Somali phrase "Soo rar" — meaning call us, and we will move it safely for you!
about.story: Founded in Mogadishu, SOORAR transformed local moving from informal pickups into a trusted, uniformed, and insured service. Whether moving a family apartment in Hodan or an NGO headquarters in Wadajir, our blue-uniformed crew treats every item like their own.
about.missionDesc: To deliver stress-free, punctual, and damage-free home and office relocations across Mogadishu with 100% honest pricing.
about.visionDesc: To be East Africa's most trusted residential and commercial moving and logistics partner.
